title: Federal Reserve
purpose: To show the transmission mechanism, and to stop you saying the Fed sets mortgage rates.
question: What is the Fed doing to rates?
how_to_read: The Fed moves the front end. Your rate follows the 10-year and the spread. The chain breaks often.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.caveat: FRED mirrors a source with its own lag. For anything time-critical, check the originating agency.

sources.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury
sources.caveat: Par yields derived from the on-the-run bid side at roughly 3:30 pm ET. Not intraday. A big afternoon move lands in tomorrow’s print.
